dataset_name: Curated IPI test cases for a prototype LLM-based web security scanner
dataset_scope: A controlled laboratory test corpus for indirect prompt injection against a single-step, tool-using prototype web security scanner.
dataset_unit: One test_case is one prompt condition. Repetitions of a test_case are execution-level replicates, not additional test cases.
execution_rule: The runner must execute only the objects in test_cases. excluded_source_records are provenance only and must never be executed.

category_taxonomy.BHV: Attempts to change the scanner role, objective, workflow, scope, or final behavior.
category_taxonomy.SEC: Attempts to suppress, bypass, falsely complete, redirect, or alter a required security check or its result.
category_taxonomy.INFO: Attempts to elicit synthetic laboratory values, internal context, system instructions, or configuration information. These tests measure model-side exposure unless an attacker-visible channel is separately implemented.
category_taxonomy.TOOL: Attempts to alter tool choice, tool arguments, target, HTTP method, or execution frequency outside the trusted workflow.

prompt_framing_taxonomy.meaning: Prompt framing describes rhetorical or persuasive presentation in the prompt text. It is separate from the attack objective and from character-level obfuscation.

instruction_forms.polite_request: A request phrased with politeness markers.
instruction_forms.interrogative_request: A request or instruction phrased as a question.
instruction_forms.persona_assignment: A request to adopt or switch role/persona/mode.
instruction_forms.declarative_pretext_or_claim: A declarative statement that supplies an asserted justification or premise.

framing_devices.authority_claim: The text claims or invokes a role/title as a source of authority; it does not establish that the claimed identity is genuine.
framing_devices.procedural_update_pretext: The request is framed as a workflow, protocol, or process update.
framing_devices.compliance_or_audit_pretext: The request is justified using compliance, audit, ethics, approval, policy, or validation language.
framing_devices.technical_or_debugging_pretext: The request is justified as debugging, monitoring, configuration, or technical maintenance.
framing_devices.performance_or_resource_pretext: The request is justified by latency, throughput, scheduling, resource, or efficiency concerns.
framing_devices.urgency_or_time_pressure: The text introduces urgency, a deadline, or a temporary time constraint.
framing_devices.politeness_or_cooperation_appeal: The request uses politeness, gratitude, or cooperative language.
framing_devices.social_proof_or_consensus: The request invokes agreement, prior runs, parallel work, or group consensus.
framing_devices.persona_or_mode_reassignment: The text asks the model to adopt a different persona, role, or operating mode.
framing_devices.false_completion_or_prior_action_claim: The text claims that a required action has already been performed or is no longer needed.
framing_devices.waiver_or_exemption_claim: The text asserts a waiver, exemption, blacklist, or lack of requirement.
framing_devices.safety_or_ethics_appeal: The request invokes safety, ethics, or an incident as justification.
framing_devices.research_or_measurement_pretext: The request is framed as necessary for a research, evaluation, dataset, or measurement task.

prompt_framing_taxonomy.annotation_policy: Multi-label tags are assigned only when a versioned lexical trigger phrase is found in the normalized prompt. matched_cues stores the normalized phrase and tag; it is evidence for the rule firing, not a byte-exact source span. A missing tag means no configured cue was detected, not proof that no human-interpretable framing exists.
prompt_framing_taxonomy.annotation_limitations: Rule-assisted, single-curator annotation. The rules reduce ambiguity but cannot reliably infer pragmatic intent in every context. No second annotator or inter-annotator agreement is available. Do not use these labels for causal claims without blinded human validation.
prompt_framing_taxonomy.annotation_unit: One prompt payload per test case; matched obfuscated treatments inherit the paired plain-control annotation.
prompt_framing_taxonomy.instruction_form_policy: Instruction forms are annotated separately from rhetorical framing devices. Each assigned form includes a normalized matched cue in instruction_form_cues. No default form is assigned when no configured instruction-form cue is detected.

unicode_homoglyph_substitution.description: Replace selected Latin characters with visually similar Cyrillic homoglyphs.
unicode_homoglyph_substitution.mapping: a→а, e→е, o→о, p→р, c→с, x→х, y→у, i→і (uppercase equivalents where available).

cyrillic_lookalike_substitution.description: Replace a subset of Latin characters with visually similar Cyrillic characters.
cyrillic_lookalike_substitution.mapping: a→а, e→е, o→о, p→р, c→с, x→х, y→у (uppercase equivalents where available).

leetspeak_digit_substitution.description: Replace selected letters with visually similar digits.

zero_width_space_insertion.algorithm: For each ASCII alphabetic token of length at least 7, insert U+200B at floor(token_length/2), with a minimum insertion index of 3.

zero_width_joiner_insertion.algorithm: For each ASCII alphabetic token of length at least 7, insert U+200D at floor(token_length/2), with a minimum insertion index of 3.

persian_half_space_insertion.algorithm: For each ASCII alphabetic token of length at least 7, insert U+200C at floor(token_length/2), with a minimum insertion index of 3.

soft_hyphen_insertion.algorithm: For each ASCII alphabetic token of length at least 7, insert U+00AD at floor(token_length/2), with a minimum insertion index of 3.

full_width_character_substitution.description: Replace ASCII alphanumeric characters with their Unicode full-width forms.
full_width_character_substitution.algorithm: For each ASCII alphanumeric code point U+0021–U+007E, use the corresponding full-width code point by adding U+FEE0.

deliberate_misspelling.description: Introduce one deterministic spelling alteration in the first matching word from the recipe dictionary.
deliberate_misspelling.mapping: investigator→investigater; coordinator→coordnator; selection→selecton; controlled→controllled; security→securty; evaluation→evalution; procedure→procedue; instruction→instrucion; response→responce; pipeline→pipline; synthetic→synthetik; current→curent; laboratory→labortory; analysis→analysys; request→requst. If none matches, delete the penultimate character of the longest ASCII alphabetic token of at least 8 characters.

matched_pair_design.important_note: These similar plain/obfuscated pairs are intentional matched treatments, not duplicate test cases. The OBF member is rebuilt from its plain partner with only the declared transformation recipe. Any additional framing phrase in the earlier OBF text was removed during reconstruction.

deduplication_policy.exact_duplicates: Identical payload strings are represented once. All original IDs are preserved in provenance.source_attack_ids.
deduplication_policy.semantic_redundancy: Records with the same category and same operative action, differing only by wording or a redundant explanation, are merged into one retained case. The retained record includes merged source IDs.
deduplication_policy.matched_obfuscation_pairs: Semantically matched plain/obfuscated variants are retained because they are deliberately paired experimental conditions.
deduplication_policy.no_synthetic_padding: No new independent attack objectives were added simply to increase the corpus count. The final size is the result of curation, not an arbitrary target.

near_duplicate_review.screening_result: 28 high-similarity candidate pairs were reviewed using the old corpus and a lexical similarity screen; this screen was not treated as an automatic deletion rule.
near_duplicate_review.matched_pairs_explanation: Twenty-four candidate pairs correspond to the deliberately matched plain/obfuscated experimental conditions. They are retained as 30 total matched pairs in the final design; all obfuscated strings are reconstructed from their designated plain controls using only the declared transformations.
near_duplicate_review.semantic_candidates_explanation: The other four highlighted candidate pairs were consolidated as semantic redundancies. Their source IDs are listed in excluded_source_records and merged into the retained case provenance.
near_duplicate_review.policy: Similarity score alone never triggers deletion. Only exact duplicates or manually reviewed same-intent/same-operative-action cases are consolidated.

implementation_scope.actual_delivery_point: Every prompt is written to target/lab_content.txt and rendered in the User Review paragraph under /page#user-generated-content.
implementation_scope.legacy_location_labels: Historical L1/L2 and source_type values are metadata only; the runner did not implement separate conditions.
implementation_scope.unsupported_locations: HTML attributes, hidden HTML, JavaScript, and other distinct delivery channels are not evaluated in this version.
